# Checks on ordinary photos

Someone who never saw the unit's activity answered the questions below about each of 120 photos: all photos of the 12 photo classes on which the unit is most active on average (necklace, wallet, Christmas stocking, holster, rubber eraser, pencil sharpener, prayer rug, pick, ocarina, mailbag, pinwheel, Loafer). For each answer: the number of photos given it, and d, how much more (positive) or less (negative) active the unit is on them than on the other photos, after removing the differences between classes, in standard deviations. Each question also has a separation score, the share of the unit's within-class variation that its answers account for. Each number comes with this unit's percentile among all 832 units of its layer, computed on the same photos and answers (above 95 or below 5 is unusual for this layer).

Q1. Does the photo show a close-up of a compact man-made or handmade object (e.g., computer mouse, shoe, teapot, knee pad, stocking, brooch)?
separation: percentile 99
- No man-made object is prominent: 0 photos (too few to compare)
- Man-made object present but small or distant: 10 photos, d -1.51, percentile 0
- Man-made object fills much of the frame: 110 photos, d +1.51, percentile 100

Q2. How prominent are smooth curved or arc-shaped contours (rounded edges, outlines) in the photo?
separation: percentile 34
- None or barely visible: 7 photos, d +0.19, percentile 81
- Some curved contours among mostly straight edges: 59 photos, d -0.19, percentile 10
- Curved contours dominate the image: 54 photos, d +0.15, percentile 82

Q3. Does the main curved contour belong to the outline of an object or to a decorative pattern on a surface?
separation: percentile 67
- No notable curved contour: 5 photos, d -0.25, percentile 43
- Object outline (e.g., edge of a shoe or mouse): 83 photos, d -0.31, percentile 8
- Decorative pattern on a surface: 18 photos, d +0.35, percentile 93
- Both equally: 14 photos, d +0.31, percentile 83

Q4. Does the photo contain ornamental radial, floral, or petal-like patterns made of repeated curved strokes (e.g., brooch, manhole cover, printed flowers, crochet)?
separation: percentile 72
- No: 69 photos, d -0.30, percentile 6
- Yes, a small or faint pattern: 31 photos, d +0.18, percentile 86
- Yes, a large or prominent pattern: 20 photos, d +0.29, percentile 85

Q5. How strongly does the main curved object or shape contrast with its background?
separation: percentile 48
- No curved object or shape: 4 photos (too few to compare)
- Low contrast, blends into background: 2 photos (too few to compare)
- Moderate contrast: 67 photos, d -0.15, percentile 36
- High contrast, clearly separated from background: 47 photos, d +0.15, percentile 64

Q6. Is the main curved shape convex (bulging outward, like a mouse or shoe toe) or more like a thin curved line (like a collar or neckline)?
separation: percentile 58
- No main curved shape: 7 photos, d +0.19, percentile 81
- Convex rounded form: 59 photos, d +0.05, percentile 61
- Thin curved line or edge: 11 photos, d +0.47, percentile 91
- Mixed or unclear: 43 photos, d -0.27, percentile 10

Q7. Is the photo a natural scene (landscape, animals, sky) rather than an object or crafted item?
separation: percentile 94
- Yes, mainly natural scene: 0 photos (too few to compare)
- Mixed natural and man-made: 9 photos, d -1.06, percentile 1
- No, mainly man-made objects or crafts: 111 photos, d +1.06, percentile 99

Q8. Does a garment or worn item with a curved edge (collar, neckline, stocking, knee pad) appear in the photo?
separation: percentile 21
- No garment or worn item: 73 photos, d +0.08, percentile 79
- Garment present but curved edges not noticeable: 21 photos, d -0.13, percentile 20
- Garment with clearly visible curved edge: 26 photos, d -0.01, percentile 56

Q9. Which way is the main subject facing or pointing?
separation: percentile 81
- left: 15 photos, d -0.35, percentile 17
- right: 22 photos, d +0.10, percentile 69
- toward or away from the camera: 48 photos, d -0.27, percentile 8
- no clear facing direction or no single main subject: 35 photos, d +0.43, percentile 96

Q10. How much of the photo does the main subject take up?
separation: percentile 25
- less than a quarter: 4 photos (too few to compare)
- a quarter to three quarters: 53 photos, d -0.07, percentile 41
- more than three quarters: 47 photos, d -0.04, percentile 47
- no single main subject: 16 photos, d +0.22, percentile 73

Q11. Is the main subject cut off by an edge of the photo?
separation: percentile 44
- fully inside the photo: 33 photos, d +0.04, percentile 69
- partly cut off: 73 photos, d -0.16, percentile 22
- no single main subject: 14 photos, d +0.30, percentile 76

Q12. Where is the center of the main subject left to right?
separation: percentile 96
- left third: 3 photos (too few to compare)
- middle third: 87 photos, d -0.56, percentile 3
- right third: 4 photos (too few to compare)
- no single main subject: 26 photos, d +0.56, percentile 97

Q13. How brightly lit is the main subject?
separation: percentile 86
- dark: 1 photos (too few to compare)
- medium: 78 photos, d -0.39, percentile 5
- bright: 32 photos, d +0.30, percentile 91
- no single main subject: 9 photos, d +0.39, percentile 90

Q14. Does the photo have an overall color tint?
separation: percentile 13
- no noticeable tint: 43 photos, d +0.16, percentile 71
- warm (yellow, orange or red) tint: 58 photos, d -0.04, percentile 38

Q15. Are the horizon or the main straight lines in the photo tilted?
